name: r1104_s_reach
hookRule: He reaches 89 in. Not everyone does.
script: Le Corbusier designed around a man who is six feet tall, with his arm raised to eighty-nine inches. But not everyone can reach that high.
The ADA limits the highest reach to forty-eight inches, and the lowest to fifteen. So move every switch and outlet into that band, before you send the plan.
Comment REACH, and I'll send you the free one page cheat sheet with all five.
